text.en: Clients express deep appreciation for lead trainer Emily and her coaching team, noting their intuitive understanding of dog behavior and relatable teaching style. Reviewers appreciate that instructors coach both puppies and handlers with patience and constructive guidance.

Pet parents report excellent behavioral outcomes across puppy foundations, adolescent training, and leash manner workshops. Multiple owners highlight that formerly unruly or reactive dogs developed reliable listening skills, stopped pulling, and learned to manage real-world distractions.

Reviewers emphasize how much their dogs look forward to training sessions, agility courses, and boarding stays. Pet parents describe dogs forming affectionate bonds with the trainers, gaining confidence through positive reinforcement, and thriving in structured environments.

q.en: Does Canine Sports Dog Training offer puppy foundation classes?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently praise the puppy classes for teaching essential socialization, focus, and early household manners.

q.en: Are in-home private lessons available from the trainers?

a.en: Yes, clients note that trainers provide in-home and outdoor private sessions to address specific behaviors like leash pulling.

q.en: Do clients use the facility for boarding and daycare?

a.en: Yes, multiple pet parents mention returning to the facility for boarding and daycare in addition to obedience classes.
